class TestParameterExpressionSecurityFix(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test that validates the security fix for ParameterExpression parsing."""

    def test_invalid_parameter_expression_str_raises_error(self):
        """Test that ParameterExpression with invalid _symbol_expr raises QiskitError in __str__."""
        # Create a ParameterExpression with an invalid _symbol_expr
        # This simulates what could happen with malformed QPY data
        param = Parameter("test_param")
        expr = ParameterExpression(param, {})
        
        # Manually set _symbol_expr to an invalid type to trigger the check
        # This would have caused problems before the fix
        expr._symbol_expr = "not_a_symengine_object"
        
        # Before the fix, this would have worked but with potential security issues
        # After the fix, this should raise QiskitError
        with self.assertRaises(QiskitError):
            str(expr)

    def test_invalid_parameter_expression_eq_raises_error(self):
        """Test that ParameterExpression with invalid _symbol_expr raises QiskitError in __eq__."""
        # Create a ParameterExpression with an invalid _symbol_expr
        param = Parameter("test_param")
        expr1 = ParameterExpression(param, {})
        expr2 = ParameterExpression(param, {})
        
        # Manually set _symbol_expr to an invalid type to trigger the check
        expr1._symbol_expr = "not_a_symengine_object"
        
        # Before the fix, this would have worked but with potential security issues
        # After the fix, this should raise QiskitError
        with self.assertRaises(QiskitError):
            _ = expr1 == expr2

    def test_parameter_expression_with_valid_symbol_expr_works(self):
        """Test that valid ParameterExpression objects work normally."""
        param = Parameter("test_param")
        expr = ParameterExpression(param, {param: 1.0})
        
        # This should work fine
        str_result = str(expr)
        self.assertIsInstance(str_result, str)
        
        # Equality should also work
        expr2 = ParameterExpression(param, {param: 1.0})
        self.assertTrue(expr == expr2)
